text:
B: Hello? Sorry, is it working?
A: Yeah, I think so. Hiya. Erm, sorry, I've never done one of these. Am I doing it right?
B: I don't know, I've only done the one. I think you just talk. I'm Joanne.
A: Jodie. Do you know what they're paying for this, by the way? Cause I couldn't find it on the email.
B: Oh, erm, I think it was a voucher? I didn't really look, sorry.
A: Nah, it's fine, I'll check after. I'm a student so, like, every tenner counts, do you know what I mean.
B: What are you studying?
A: UX design, at Birmingham City. It's like, designing apps and websites so they're not rubbish to use. I used to do banners at a print place in Wednesbury, which was proper boring, so I've gone back to retrain. For the money, basically. I'm not gonna pretend it's a calling.
B: That's very brave, going back. I couldn't do that.
A: Erm, brave or daft, I'll let you know when I've got a job. What about you?
B: I clean at the hospital. In Basingstoke. On the wards.
A: Oh, right. Is that, like, early starts and that?
B: Half five. I'm shattered by about two o'clock, sorry, so I'm probably not very lively.
A: Nah, you're alright. My boyfriend's on early starts too, he's a sparky, he's up and gone before I've even moved. I'm more of a, like, two in the morning person. That's when I do all my work, the night before, in a panic.
B: My Kirsty was like that with her homework.
A: Was she? See, it's a type. Erm... sorry, I'm rubbish with silences.
B: No, me too. Erm, was that your cat, in your picture? On the chair?
A: Yeah, that's Mabel. She's a rescue. She knocks everything off my desk, like, pens, my stylus, a full cup of tea last week, all over my sketches.
B: Oh no. Ours is called Biscuit, she's nineteen. She doesn't knock much off anymore, she just sort of sleeps. Funny thing, the lady I talked to before, her dog's called Biscuit as well.
A: No way. It's a good name though, to be fair.
B: What do you do in the evenings, when you're not studying? If that's not nosy.
A: Telly, mostly. Love Island, Married at First Sight. And true crime, which is a mistake cause it gives me anxiety and then I'm up checking the back door, do you know what I mean?
B: Oh, I do that! I watch them documentaries and then I can't sleep, and Gary says, well, why do you watch them then.
A: Ryan says exactly that! Word for word. Erm, do you go on holiday or anything?
B: Just the caravan mostly, in Dorset. We've done Majorca. I don't like flying though, I get in a right state at the airport.
A: Oh my God, same. I can't do airports. Ryan does all the booking, I just get told what gate. I want to go to Japan one day but, like, that's a twelve-hour flight, I'd be a wreck.
B: I don't think I'd go that far. The Canaries was far enough for me.
A: Tenerife's nice though, yeah? We did Tenerife.
B: Yes, we've been to Tenerife. It was lovely. Very hot.
A: See, that's all you need. Sun and a pool and someone else sorting it.
B: Gary had a full English every day. Every single day, sorry, I don't know why I'm telling you that.
A: Nah, that's a proper holiday, that. Oh, is that the timer? It goes quick, dunt it.
